why_two_arms: the relaxed guard attaches a fresh identity organ and any budget adds training, so a single arm cannot separate data distribution from those two effects

stop_definitions.regression: material: any mechanised delta <= -0.1 (two items of twenty); persistent: the same dimension below P3a at two consecutive checkpoints; or B/G pending-review count above P3a
stop_definitions.stage_scoring: the live checkpoint is copied to checkpoints/p3b/snapshots before scoring, because a stage costs ~205 s while the trainer overwrites the file
